objective.subject: test: check group members, combines and single tasks at admission
objective.body:
PIT discovery on 8b883a1a (batch C, all root-package tests) left two
mutants SURVIVED in unchanged TaskGroup code:
TaskGroup$PreparationContext.prepareMember and prepareTerminalCombine,
"removed call to Par::diagnoseAdmission". Their only killing test was
the deleted TaskTypeMismatchWarningTest. API and options section 3.2.1
(Admission diagnostics) still requires every unit, including a group
member and a group combine, to be checked at admission, so the deleted
test had been the only evidence for a live rule.

InertEnqueueRefusalWarningTest now runs a refusing member, a refusing
combine and a refusing single task on three plain-queue Pars and
expects one inert-refusal warning for each Par.

Reverse verification: deleting either diagnoseAdmission call in
TaskGroup fails the new test with "Expected size: 3 but was: 2";
restoring the call makes it pass. The single-task path shares
Par.admitUnit with batches, whose call is already killed.

InertEnqueueRefusalWarningTest and TaskGroupTest (47 tests) pass, and
spotless, check-verification-integrity.py --base f093bb12 and
check-java-conventions.py pass.
